diagnosis: The Next.js App Router route handler verifies that a valid user session exists, but looks up the invoice solely by params.invoiceId without verifying that the invoice belongs to params.orgSlug or that session.user.id is an authorized member of that organization. Any logged-in user can view private corporate billing invoices of other companies.
exploit_request:
GET /api/organizations/acme-corp/invoices/inv_9981204 HTTP/1.1
Host: portal.cloudsaas.io
Cookie: authjs.session-token=<attacker_cookie>
